run_agent: run an agent against a bot or another agent on a specified StarCraft II map
run_parallel_agents: run multiple agent instances in parallel across separate threads
configure_agent_interface: configure the agent interface format with feature screen and minimap resolutions
run_agent_with_profiling: run an agent with code profiling enabled to measure execution performance
run_two_agent_match: run a two-agent match with configurable difficulty and bot build strategy
